bio.text: Denise Garner represents District 20 in the Arkansas House of Representatives, which includes part of Washington County, and is serving her fourth term; she first served in 2019.
Garner is a retired RNP and small business owner who attended Baylor and graduated from the University of Arkansas Medical School with a B.S.N. and R.N.P.
